links.comparator_used: Clinical text-only prompting and prompting without medical imaging input.
links.outcome: Clinical reasoning quality; diagnostic accuracy and safety were not significantly different.
links.effect: Clinical reasoning scores: F(3,123) = 4.32, p = 0.0058; ranked first or second in six of seven evaluation domains; no significant differences in diagnostic accuracy or safety.
links.quote: Combining structured literature and imaging with clinical text significantly improved clinical reasoning scores (F(3,123) = 4.32, p = 0.0058), ranking first or second in six of seven evaluation domains.
